skills.summary: Sort a messy folder into a clean structure
skills.job: Plan and apply a folder structure for a messy directory, with a dry-run list first.
triggers: clean up my downloads folder
organise these files
sort this folder by type and date
gotchas: moving before the plan is approved
name collisions overwrite files
moving project folders that belong together

skills.summary: Rename many files by a rule, safely
skills.job: Rename a set of files by a pattern with a preview table and an undo log.
triggers: rename all these photos
add a date prefix to every file
replace spaces with dashes in filenames
gotchas: two files map to one new name
extension changed by accident
case-only renames fail on Windows

skills.summary: Find duplicate files by content hash
skills.job: Find exact duplicate files by size then hash and propose which copy to keep.
triggers: find duplicate files
which of these photos are the same
free up space by removing copies
gotchas: same name is not same content
hardlinks and shortcuts counted as copies
deleting without a keep rule

skills.summary: Turn extracted PDF text into clean prose
skills.job: Repair text pulled from a PDF: hyphenation, headers, footers, column order, ligatures.
triggers: the text from this pdf is a mess
clean up copied pdf text
remove page numbers and headers from the extract
gotchas: multi-column pages read across columns
real hyphens removed with line-break hyphens
footnotes merged into body text

skills.summary: Fix OCR errors in scanned text
skills.job: Correct typical OCR misreads in scanned-document text without inventing content.
triggers: fix the OCR errors
this scan text has garbage characters
clean up text from a scanned page
gotchas: digits and letters swapped in numbers
silently fixing what the scan really says
names and codes treated like dictionary words

skills.summary: Merge, split and reorder PDF pages
skills.job: Combine, split or reorder PDF pages with a page map confirmed before writing.
triggers: merge these pdfs
split this pdf into chapters
pull pages 3 to 7 out of a pdf
gotchas: page numbers printed differ from index
bookmarks and links lost on merge
overwriting the source file

skills.summary: Fill a form from known data, flag the gaps
skills.job: Fill a PDF or document form from supplied data and list every field left blank or guessed.
triggers: fill in this form for me
complete this application with my details
populate the fields from this data
gotchas: guessing values for unknown fields
date and phone formats the form expects
checkbox and radio fields set by label not value

skills.summary: Convert Markdown to a styled Word file
skills.job: Convert a Markdown file to docx with a style mapping and a render check.
triggers: turn this markdown into a word doc
export my notes as docx
convert readme to word
gotchas: tables and code blocks lose formatting
relative image paths break
heading levels skipped in source

skills.summary: Fill a Word template with data
skills.job: Fill placeholders in a docx template from a data row and check nothing is left unfilled.
triggers: fill this letter template for each client
mail merge into word
replace the placeholders in this template
gotchas: placeholders split across runs in the XML
headers and footers skipped
long values overflow the layout

skills.summary: Plan a deck: one message per slide
skills.job: Turn a brief or source material into a slide-by-slide outline with one claim per slide.
triggers: outline a presentation on this
plan the slides for my talk
how many slides do I need
gotchas: topic titles instead of claims
no audience or time limit asked
agenda slide eating the first minutes

skills.summary: Write speaker notes that fit the time
skills.job: Write speaker notes per slide that add to the slide and fit the talk length.
triggers: write speaker notes for this deck
what should I say on each slide
add notes to my presentation
gotchas: notes that read the slide aloud
speaking time ignored
transitions between slides missing

skills.job: Diff two versions of a document and report meaningful changes apart from formatting noise.
triggers: what changed between these two versions
compare these documents
diff the old and new report
gotchas: formatting changes drown real edits
moved paragraphs shown as delete plus add
comparing a draft to the wrong base

skills.summary: Pull tables out of documents into CSV
skills.job: Extract tables from PDFs, Word or web pages into clean CSV with a check against the source.
triggers: extract the table from this pdf
get this table into excel
pull the data tables out of the report
gotchas: merged cells shift columns
tables split across pages
numbers with thousands separators read as text

skills.summary: Assemble a meeting pack from many files
skills.job: Collect agenda, papers and prior minutes into one ordered pack with an index.
triggers: put together the board pack
assemble the meeting papers
compile everything for tomorrow's meeting
gotchas: stale versions of a paper included
order differs from the agenda
file size too large to send

skills.summary: Archive a folder and verify the copy
skills.job: Create a dated archive or backup of a folder and verify it by listing and checksum.
triggers: back up this folder
zip up the project for archive
make a dated copy before I change things
gotchas: backup stored beside the original
open or locked files skipped silently
never test-restoring the archive

skills.summary: Design a filename convention for a team
skills.job: Define a short filename convention with examples, then check existing files against it.
triggers: we need a naming convention for files
how should I name these documents
standardise our file names
gotchas: too many fields in the name
dates not sortable
convention nobody can remember
